text:
jess: Heads up — p99 just spiked from 120ms -> 1.1s on shard gcp-us-west-3 for model-realtime. Alerting because this looks like a kernel selection path issue :rotating_light:
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1998765432 (latency spike) — paging eng-runtime on-call
marco: Looking at the kernel histograms now. early sign: a bunch of requests fell back to the generic GEMM kernel for steps >1024, latency distribution skews right
izzy: posted a short profile; KV cache miss rate jumped at the same time. suspect noisy tenant evicting prefixes -> cache thrash. snippet:
```
kernel_choice: optimized_attention_v2 -> fallback_gemm_generic
seq_len: 1536
kv_cache_hit: 0.12 -> 0.03
latency_p99: 120ms -> 1.05s
```
riley: If KV cache is thrashing, we should throttle the noisy tenant and route other traffic to the quantized-8bit variant temporarily. throttling buys us headroom for kernel fix
devon: I can flip the tenant throttle now (rate_limit=0.25) and enable routing fallback for prod-us-west. running:
`redwoodctl route set --tenant noisy-tenant --fallback model-quant-8b --enable`
jess: Throttle applied. initial telemetry shows p99 down to ~350ms but throughput took a ~15% hit. looks like batching got smaller due to the routing change
marco: Batching heuristics need a tweak — small-window batching disabled for this shard caused more tiny batches. pushing a temporary cap: max_batch_size=64 for model-realtime on gcp-us-west-3
izzy: After cap change, queue depth stabilized and average tokens/sec returned near baseline. KV hit-rate climbed back to ~0.68. monitoring panels: https://grafana/redwood/d/model-realtime
sam: Good. I'll coordinate a canary to prod-other-region for the kernel selection fix. also notifying SRE and support about customer-facing impact
devon: Feature flag `kernel_force_select=v2` set for canary (10% traffic). logs show fallback paths removed for typical seq_len <=1024. running a 15m canary now
izzy: Can confirm canary p95/p99 improved. plan: keep throttle + routing fallback for 10 more mins, let canary run, then promote kernel selector alongside batching revert
ops-bot: Incident update: INC-2026-1998765432 — mitigation in place (tenant throttle + routing fallback + batch cap). Status: monitoring
jess: Monitoring looks stable for 8m, p99 trending down. prepare RCA and schedule deeper profiling on kernel selector heuristics tomorrow. thanks all :thumbsup:
sam: I'll open the incident page with links to the logs, flamegraphs, and the quick mitigation steps we ran. assigning follow-ups to marco/izzy for root cause and devon for playbook updates
jess: closing thread for now — keep posting if anything regresses
